timeless:parts.name: trigger

timeless:parts.description: A `<template>` holding the markup for one chip. Timeless clones it per selected value and fills it in, so every element and class in a chip is yours. Without it a `chips` container receives a plain comma-separated summary instead.

timeless:parts.name: chip
timeless:parts.description: One selected value, authored inside `chip-template`.

timeless:parts.name: chip-label
timeless:parts.description: Where the selected label is written inside a chip. Omit it only when the chip has no other content.

timeless:parts.name: chip-remove
timeless:parts.description: Removes its chip. Author it as a real button; Timeless gives it the value it removes and an accessible name naming that value, since one shared template cannot. An `aria-label` you author wins.

timeless:parts.name: clear
timeless:parts.description: Empties the whole selection. Disabled while there is nothing to clear.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Corner or edge of the viewport the toasts stack against.

attributes.name: stack
attributes.description: Whether queued toasts overlap into a deck (`overlap`) or lay out as a full list (`list`).

members.name: placement
members.description: Corner or edge of the viewport the toasts stack against.

members.name: stack
members.description: Whether queued toasts overlap into a deck (`overlap`) or lay out as a full list (`list`).

cssProperties.name: --ui-toaster-overlap
cssProperties.description: Offset between stacked toasts in `overlap` mode.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds before the toast dismisses itself. `0` keeps it open until dismissed.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: Present to disable auto-dismiss regardless of `duration`.

members.name: duration
members.description: Milliseconds before the toast dismisses itself. `0` keeps it open until dismissed.

members.name: persistent
members.description: Present to disable auto-dismiss regardless of `duration`.

events.name: ui-dismiss
events.description: Dispatched when the toast is dismissed. The detail names the reason: a timeout, the close control, or the imperative API.

cssStates.name: --closed
cssStates.description: Set while the toast plays its exit transition. Internal; do not author it.

timeless:parts.name: content
timeless:parts.description: Wrapper for the title and description.

timeless:parts.name: title
timeless:parts.description: Short summary line.

timeless:parts.name: description
timeless:parts.description: Supporting detail.

timeless:parts.name: close
timeless:parts.description: Dismiss button. Give it an accessible name.

attributes.name: attached
attributes.description: Present to join the buttons into one segmented control. Styling only, resolved by `toggle.css`.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Layout and arrow-key axis.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.description: Whether pressing one button releases the others (`single`) or toggles independently (`multiple`).

members.name: orientation
members.description: Layout and arrow-key axis.

members.name: selection
members.description: Whether pressing one button releases the others (`single`) or toggles independently (`multiple`).

events.name: ui-before-change
events.description: Cancelable proposal dispatched before the pressed set changes. Call `preventDefault()` to reject the transition and keep the current value.

events.name: ui-change
events.description: Dispatched after the pressed set has changed. Bubbles and is composed.

timeless:parts.name: item
timeless:parts.description: One toggle button. Author `value` and `aria-pressed`; Timeless keeps the pressed set in sync.

events.name: input
events.description: Native `input` event dispatched on the inner number input after each step.

events.name: change
events.description: Native `change` event dispatched on the inner number input.

timeless:parts.name: input
timeless:parts.description: The native number input. `min`, `max`, and `step` come from it, and native validation keeps working.

timeless:parts.name: decrement
timeless:parts.description: Button that steps down. Give it an accessible name.

timeless:parts.name: increment
timeless:parts.description: Button that steps up. Give it an accessible name.

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Color space the channel controls edit and the raw input round-trips through. The picker converts the current value when this changes.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial and form-reset color, in any CSS color syntax. Unlike the collection elements, the picker reflects one `value` property rather than a separate authored default.

members.name: format
members.description: Color space the channel controls edit and the raw input round-trips through. The picker converts the current value when this changes.

members.name: value
members.description: Initial and form-reset color, in any CSS color syntax. Unlike the collection elements, the picker reflects one `value` property rather than a separate authored default.

events.name: input
events.description: Native `input` event dispatched while the color is being edited.

events.name: change
events.description: Native `change` event dispatched when the edit is committed.

cssStates.name: --contextual
cssStates.description: Set while the picker renders inside a popover surface. Internal; do not author it.

cssStates.name: --copied
cssStates.description: Set briefly after the value is copied. Internal; do not author it.

timeless:parts.name: preview
timeless:parts.description: Region holding the format select, gamut controls, and readout.

timeless:parts.name: preview-bar
timeless:parts.description: Row above the readout.

timeless:parts.name: format-field
timeless:parts.description: Label wrapper around the format select.

timeless:parts.name: format
timeless:parts.description: Native `<select>` listing the supported color formats.

timeless:parts.name: gamut-bar
timeless:parts.description: Row holding the clamp buttons.

timeless:parts.name: clamp
timeless:parts.description: Button that clamps an out-of-gamut color into sRGB or P3. Shown only when needed.

timeless:parts.name: readout
timeless:parts.description: Row holding the swatch, raw input, and copy button.

timeless:parts.name: gamut
timeless:parts.description: Current-color swatch. Decorative.

timeless:parts.name: input
timeless:parts.description: Raw CSS color value, editable as text.

timeless:parts.name: input-label
timeless:parts.description: Screen-reader label for the raw input or format select.

timeless:parts.name: copy
timeless:parts.description: Copies the raw value to the clipboard.

timeless:parts.name: copy-icon
timeless:parts.description: Idle state of the copy button. Decorative.

timeless:parts.name: copied-icon
timeless:parts.description: Confirmed state of the copy button. Decorative.

timeless:parts.name: channels
timeless:parts.description: Container for the per-channel rows.

timeless:parts.name: channel
timeless:parts.description: One channel row. The picker rewrites the rows when `format` changes, so author one row per channel of the widest format you support.

timeless:parts.name: channel-label
timeless:parts.description: Channel name. Written by the picker; decorative.

timeless:parts.name: channel-range
timeless:parts.description: Slider for one channel.

timeless:parts.name: channel-input
timeless:parts.description: Numeric entry for one channel.

timeless:parts.name: warning
timeless:parts.description: Out-of-gamut or unparsable-value message.

timeless:parts.name: trigger
timeless:parts.description: Optional button when the picker lives inside a popover.

timeless:parts.name: content
timeless:parts.description: Optional popover surface wrapping the picker.
